caption: Source Record
description: A native source record retained whole because no normalization rule covers it, or because it could not be parsed. This is the whole-record fallback; it makes vendor detail reachable in Level 1 without Level 0. Independently understood execution metrics may accompany a record whose remaining meaning has no normalization rule.
name: source_record

1.caption: Parsed
1.description: The record parsed as one JSON object and is retained in data.

2.caption: Opaque
2.description: The record could not be parsed as one JSON object; it is retained as text or bytes.

cli_agent.description: The CLI agent is stored once per run in run.json shared.cli_agent (0.2.0); it is present on an event only in a self-contained export.

basis.description: Why the record was retained whole (no rule, or the parse failure reason).

raw_data.description: The record text verbatim when it decodes as UTF-8 but is not one JSON object.

assembly.description: Present in a finally assembled file: this event's assembly role and evidence.

data.description: The parsed record exactly as reported.

duration.description: The source-reported elapsed execution time in integral milliseconds. No start/end timestamps or aggregation window are inferred. Exact non-integral durations use execution_metrics in their native unit.
